column1: # Failure classes of red CI and e2e jobs, read by hack/ci-fail.sh. ORDER MATTERS: the first row whose
# regex matches a line of the job log wins; no match is class `unknown` (retry `unknown`).
# Columns, tab separated: category, retry (yes|no), POSIX extended regex (grep -E, case sensitive).
# Put a specific row above a generic one (a race and a timeout also print `--- FAIL`). Infra rows come
# first: a runner that lost DNS also fails the steps after it. Add a row when a failure shows as
# `unknown`, and add a log sample under hack/testdata/ci-fail/ (hack/ci-fail-test.sh checks both).
# Retry `yes` means a plain re-run is a fair first step; `no` means read the failure.
